summary: This Form 6-K from Nebius Group N.V. reports first-quarter 2025 and 2026 operating and financial results. It includes a management discussion and analysis along with unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements. The filing describes Nebius as a global AI cloud platform with segments Avride (autonomous vehicles) and TripleTen (edtech), plus minority stakes in ClickHouse and Toloka. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change — is mentioned.
